scheme_name: Msme Skill Training And Employment Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be an MSME unit operating in Tamil Nadu with the requisite infrastructure
MSME unit should have experience, expertise, and an ongoing business in the relevant vocation/trade
Trainees must possess an engineering degree, a polytechnic diploma, an ITI certificate, or qualifications prescribed by the respective sector skill council
The MSME applicant must not have been blacklisted under any government norms, rules, or acts
The applicant is required to provide a stipend of ₹5000 per month to each trainee for a maximum of 6 months
benefits_summary: MSMEs receive a subsidy of up to ₹2000 per month per trainee for up to 6 months, and trainees earn a certification from the National Skill Development Corporation.
